name: DTFSeeds Education Visual Production Queue — Harvest/Post-Harvest + Outdoor
purpose: Asset-level production plan for the next educational visual wave. It extends the canonical coverage targets without changing the existing publication boundary or placement rules.

designSystem.style: academic studio-quality cultivation education; clean neutral/cream background; natural plant color; crisp labels; no yellow cast; no decorative clutter
designSystem.textPolicy: Keep baked-in text concise. Prefer diagram labels, short callouts, legends, and captions over paragraph text.
designSystem.accuracyPolicy: No unsupported universal thresholds. Numeric targets must be source-supported and context-labeled. Diagnostic visuals must distinguish observation from interpretation.
designSystem.accessibilityPolicy: Every asset requires descriptive alt text and a caption that communicates the educational point without relying on color alone.
designSystem.reviewPolicy: Artwork remains artwork-needed until visual QA, scientific QA, spelling/label QA, and page-placement QA are all complete.
